lines.en: All right, so we'll get a little coffee,
we'll get energized, and we'll head back out.
We don't need that wizard guy.
We'll hit a couple of clubs,
and after this, we'll go down to the docks
and see about that boat thing.
Yeah, but I don't want to be up too late,
Actually, can I get some hot water with a little lemon?
It strained my voice screaming in there.
Does it have to be so loud?
I can't hear a word you say
and my ears are ringing so bad.
I'm just glad I brought that extra pair of socks, you know?
I didn't want to touch a thing in that last place.
We're just not 21 anymore, you know?
and I want to sit in a comfortable chair
and go to sleep at a reasonable hour.
Yeah, and I like to hang out in a quiet place
where I can talk to my friends.
And so what if I like to go home,
